scope: Tamil-first original procedural visual studies, not historical transcriptions. No deities, invented Tamil words or celebrity pictures.

categories.kaleidoscope: Original repeatable segment studies from Tamil kolam geometry, southern textiles, botanical ornament and temple-car craft. Sources remain single segments, not baked radial patterns. Ornamental eye is a feather-eye motif, not a religious emblem.
categories.optical: Contemporary optical compositions derived from Tamil threshold geometry, wooden temple-car wheels, textile repeats and local floral forms. These are decorative studies, not sacred diagrams or named historical designs.
categories.impact: Celebratory print marks and rhythmic floral or geometric dispersal. No weapons, literal explosions, deity symbols or Western comic-book insignia.
categories.transitions: Ornamental alpha mattes motivated by wheels, leaves, textile edges and kolam. Transparent gutters are intentional; expand the matte in your edit to cover a full frame.
categories.hero: Original neutral human silhouette only. Supply your own rights-cleared transparent PNG or WebP; no celebrity image, user photograph or earlier hero cutout is included.
categories.typography: Demo labels are English placeholders, not lyrics. The API defaults to empty text. Tamil-inspired marks elsewhere are non-linguistic fragments, never invented Tamil words or authenticated glyphs.
categories.textures: Seeded fine pigment, paper-fibre and registration studies. No grunge, scratches or external texture photographs.

textPolicy: Only supplied text is rendered by lyric APIs. Exported demos use the literal English label PLACEHOLDER; abstract Tamil-derived curves are explicitly non-linguistic.
review: No external cultural practitioner review is claimed. Seek contextual review for ritual, heritage or community-specific commissions.
